# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.13

Version 1.4.13 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.12

**The acres around you are alive.** With seamless acres (v1.4.12) you see well into the next acres, but until now
only their buildings were there before you stepped in: the villagers out walking, the insects and the fish of an
acre came out when you crossed into it, sometimes right in front of you. Now the game keeps the world going in the
nine acres around you, as it did only in your own acre:

- villagers out walking in the acres around you are there, going about their business, before you arrive;
- each acre gets its insects and fish as walking into it gives them, once, when it comes near (one acre away, out of
  sight), so they are there when you look;
- the mayor and the other characters who stand in a given acre, balls, snowmen and the like are there too;
- Kapp'n's boat can be seen from the next acre; Kapp'n himself comes when you walk into the dock's acre, as before;
- what you leave behind stays while it is near and goes once you are further away, as before.

Nothing changes when **Settings** → **Gameplay** → **Seamless acres** is off: crossing and everything else is as on
the GameCube. Event visitors (the travelling sellers and the like) still come by the game's own rules, and so do the
villagers on the day of a gathering, the Wisp's spirits and the sea on the way to the island.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.13 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together. A guest in another player's town sees the host's villagers as before.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.13-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.13-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.13-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.13-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

With the setting **off**, the game is unchanged: the same scripted play as before (43 scenarios: the opening,
building interiors and saving, the town by day, night and rain, the Famicom, the device menus, several days with
letters, K.K. Slider, the house loan and events, Nook's part-time job, the Korean text editor), run on v1.4.12 and on
this version, gives the same 921 screenshots pixel for pixel, the same logged positions and the same saves.

With the setting **on**, in a town past its first days:

- 40 crossings over the town in every direction: the player walks on wherever the GameCube's crossing would have
  taken them, the game's acre follows every time, and no villager is ever there twice;
- villagers of the next acres are out before the player arrives, and the insects and fish of each acre come out
  once as it comes near;
- a house just across an edge is in view before the crossing;
- Kapp'n at the dock, the boat trip to the island and back, and both of the island's acres;
- walking into a building and leaving the scene right after a crossing; the title demo gives the same screenshots
  as with the setting off;
- the 32-bit and 64-bit builds give the same screenshots and positions throughout (193 screenshots), and a 64-bit
  build with AddressSanitizer and UBSan bounds checks found no memory errors (only the original game's out-of-range
  reads that are already listed in the docs).

Also:

- An independent review of the code, in three rounds; what it found is fixed (among others: the boat no longer
  comes and goes, the island keeps its own season, villager gatherings keep their actors).
- All unit tests pass. The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.13, versionCode 10413).

How it works: [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md#seamless-acres).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- No test on a real arm64 device was possible here; arm64 runs the same 64-bit code that was checked on x86_64.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
